children.name: Milax
children.description: Milax — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Milax aegaeicus Wiktor & Mylonas, 1986
children.description:
External: Preserved: dark gray body with a pattern of dark dots and sometimes reticulations in the skin grooves; dark spotting and two dark lines near the horseshoe-shaped groove; keel and lower sides creamy/light; strong keel along entire dorsum; cream 3-part sole with dark spotting in side sections (Wiktor 1987).

Internal: Epiphallus with a wide apex, and a constriction near the apex; penis shorter than epiphallus and wider at the base; penial retractor muscle branches, with the larger branch on the boundary between penis and epiphallus and the other branch on the spermatheca duct; oviduct longer than penis+epiphallus; ovate spermatheca with duct shorter than itself; 2 atrial stimultors: 1 long coiled, 1 small, hook-like; accessory glands (forming a loose ball of ducts) join atrium by many ducts, and connect to a membrane surrounding the atrium; spermatophore long and thin with 2 rows of branching hooks at wide end, with few/no hooks in the middle, and spines on the narrow end (Wiktor 1987).

Similar to M. gagates, M. altenai, M. parvulus. M. gagates does not have spots on body or sole, shorter stimulator, and spermatophore with spines throughout length. M. altenai is smaller, shorter stimulator. M.

children.name: Milax altenai Forcart, 1972
children.description:
External: Relatively thin body; strong keel along entire dorsum; preserved: cream body with dark back, somewhat darker in skin grooves; dark head; dark and horseshoe-shaped groove and spots on mantle; lighter sides; cream sole (Wiktor 1987).

Internal: Rounded penis and much thinner epiphallus; ovate spermatheca with thick duct almost the dimensions of the spermatheca; thin oviduct; short atrium with glandular exterior; large accessory gland connected by 18 ducts to atrium; wide, tongue-like atrial stimulator with hook on the end and hollowed on the inner side; internal papilla each where vagina and penis meet the atrium (Wiktor 1987; Yildirim & Kebapçi 2004).

Similar to M. parvulus but wide, short stimulator with a hollow inner side (Wiktor 1987).

children.name: Milax caucasicus
children.description: Milax caucasicus is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Milax gagates
children.description: Milax gagates, known by the common name greenhouse slug, is a species of air-breathing, keeled, land slug, a shell-less terrestrial gastropod mollusc in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Milax gasulli van Regteren Altena, 1974
children.description:
External: Dark grey body, mantle, and head; lighter sides; yellowish spots on body; weak grooves in skin; strong, light keel; cream sole (Wiktor 1987; Abbes et al. 2010).

Internal: Genitalia similar to those of M. nigricans; thin epiphallus attached to side of epiphallus apex; short, rounded epiphallus; cylindrical penis 1.5x longer than epiphallus and narrower; penial retractor attaches to constriction between epiphallus and penis; cylindrical oviduct; spermatheca duct short and differentiated from spermatheca; vagina thinner than spermatheca duct; short atrium; large atrial stimulator with spines near its end; two-lobed accessory gland connected by many long, narrow ducts to atrium; spermatophore covered with bifurcated spines and probably large (Wiktor 1987).

Externally resembles M. gagates, M. nigricans, M. ater (Wiktor 1987). Relative to M. nigricans and M. gagates, M. gasulli is smaller, lighter, and with mantle spots, and it is also distinct in having a thin, narrow stimulator with two rows of papillae and a unique spermatophore shape (Abbes et al. 2010).

children.name: Milax lopadusanus Liberto, Corso, R.Viviano, Colomba & Sparacio, 2017
Milax monstruosus Wiktor, 1986
children.description:
External: Brown body with dark pattern; distinct keel and skin grooves (Wiktor 1987).

Internal: Long, thin vas deferens; thin epiphallus broadening toward apex; thin, cylindrical penis; wide, short penial retractor muscle at bent junction of epiphallus and penis; ovate spermatheca with a small hooked, narrow end, and spermatheca duct longer than and differentiated from spermatheca; thin, twisted oviduct about as long as penis+epiphallus; 3 atrial stimulators: 1 long (as epiphallus+penis) and twisted, 2 like half-cones with pointed, bent tips; three long ducts join white accessory gland to atrium (Wiktor 1987).

children.name: Milax parvulus Wiktor, 1968
children.description:
External: Brown-black dorsum and mantle, orange keel and sole. dark gray-blue tail; dark reticulating spots and orange blotches on mantle; dark grooves in tail; black head and tentacles; strong keel; orange coloration is lost in preserved specimens (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

Internal: Conical penis+epiphallus, with the widest point at the apex of the epiphallus, and usually bent into a hook; penial retractor muscle at (indistinct) connection point of penis and ephiphallus; small papilla in penis; rounded spermatheca and thick spermatheca duct; thick, cylindrical oviduct; vagina (between oviduct+spermatheca duct and atrium) very short; barrel-shaped atrium, containing long, coiled, smooth stimulator with a crescentic cross-section; one white accessory gland, connected with 9-13 thin white ducts to the side of the atrium (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

children.name: Milax riedeli Wiktor, 1986
children.description:
External: Preserved body brown with a black pattern of reticulation in the skin grooves; sides and keel lighter; black head; small dots spread evenly over mantle; no apparent streaks on sides of body; strong grooves in skin; cream sole (Wiktor 1987).

Internal: Epiphallus club-shaped, with its apex the widest point, and equal in length to penis; strong penial retractor muscle; spermatheca wide and ovate with a distinct, thick spermatheca duct; long, bent oviduct; large, rounded atrium; accessory gland attached by many ducts to atrium; flat, wide sheet-like atrial stimulator with fringed edges and spines on the internal side (Wiktor 1987).

children.name: Milax verrucosus Wiktor, 1969
children.description:
External: Small mantle, 1/6-1/7 extended live body length; worm-like body; white to cream body, sometimes with blue-gray dorsum, and no markings; dark tentacles; uniquely papillate mantle; moderate keel along entire length of dorsum; thick, shiny, transparent mucus (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

Internal: Very small spermoviduct and large albumin gland; vas deferens, epiphallus, and penis all form one undifferentiated, short tube; thin penial retractor muscle; oviduct equal in length to vas derens+epiphallus+penis, and widening toward its base; spermatheca small and ovate with a duct equal in length to oviduct; wing-shaped accessory gland connected by one duct to atrium; no atrial stimulator (Wiktor 1983, 1987). Simple genital anatomy is probably a result of Milax verrucosus's underground habits (Wiktor 1983).

children.name: Tandonia
children.description: Tandonia — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Tandonia albanica
children.description:
External: Gray-brown with dark patterned body (waterside-dwelling) or black body (rock-dwelling); dark pigment in grooves of skin; pale sole; keel mainly on posterior end of body; clear mucus, milky with perturbation (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Long spermatheca with narrowed end and wide, thick-walled duct longer than spermatheca; cylindrical epiphallus two slight protuberances at its apex; narrow retractor muscle at constriction between epiphallus and penis; irregularly-shaped penis; very short vagina surrounded by lobed accessory glands; short atrium; thick, ciagr-shaped spermatophore, with small spines on one half and large hooks on the end of the other half (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia bosnensis Wiktor, 1986
children.description:
External: Small mantle; brown-pink body with small spots on mantle and forming reticulations in skin; pink keel; creamy sole; clear mucus, milky when perturbed (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Cylindrical or club-shaped penis+epiphallus, which are undifferentiated; long, thin penial retractor; spermatheca very long, and spermatheca and duct undifferentiated; spermatheca+duct 2.5x length of penis and epiphallus; cylindrical oviduct thinner than penis; short vagina with accessory glands around it; small atrium (Wiktor 1996).

Requires dissection to be identified (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia budapestensis
children.description: Tandonia budapestensis is a species of air-breathing, keeled, land slug, a shell-less terrestrial gastropod mollusks in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Tandonia cavicola
children.description:
External: Thick-bodied; ochre-cream body usually with a few dark flecks, and slightly darker mantle; sometimes dark reticulations formed by pigment in skin grooves; brown head and tentacles; skin thick with weak grooves; slight keel on tail; cream-white sole (Wiktor 1987; 1996).

Internal: Cylindrical epiphallus, 3-4x length of penis, and with bulbous apex; longitudinal folds inside epiphallus; short, rounded penis containing longitudinal folds and a simple papilla; thin penial retractor muscle at constriction between penis and epiphallus; tubular oviduct; long spermatheca; thick-walled spermatheca duct longer than spermatheca itself and thicker than oviduct; small accessory glands, each with its own duct, on vagina (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia cretica
children.description:
Exteral: Resembles Limax in shape; black body, head, and mantle with blue or purplish tint in life; lighter sides; fine body wrinkles; weak, pale keel; cream foot fringe and sole; clear mucus (Wiktor 1987; Wiktor et al 1994).

Internal: Light brown hermaphrodite gland; spermatheca duct longer than spermatheca; epiphallus tubular and narrowing toward its base, sometimes with rows of papillae on outside; inside thick apical section of epiphallus is a complex system of pits, and inside thinner basal section of epiphallus is longitudinal folds; constriction between epiphallus and penis, with fine penial retractor muscle attached; penis tubular and with two constrictions along its length; flat, conic papilla in central section of penis; short, thick oviduct; short vagina ~2x oviduct in width and with interior longitudinal folds; flat papilla in upper part of vagina; spermatheca irregular and slightly pointed, with a duct shorter than itself; short, cylindrical atrium; accessory glands appear like small rolls around vagina and spermatheca duct, and each has its own short, thin duct; spermathophore yellow to orange and long with a thin section covered with spines/hooks and a thick section with hooked spines only on one side (Wiktor 1987).

Very similar to T.

children.name: Tandonia cristata
children.description:
External: Small and narrow-bodied; gray-green or gray-yellow body with dark grooves in skin, darker dorsum and mantle; mantle unmarked; blackish head and tentacles; cream sole; strong keel; fine grooves in skin; translucent or slightly yellow, thick mucus (Wiktor 1983).

Internal: Vas deferens, epiphallus, and vas deferens all clearly delimited; epiphallus club-shaped and equal to or shorter than length of penis, with strong penial retractor muscle at its junction with the penis; penis rounded with an encircling constriction towards its apex and a round papilla inside; retentor muscles on side of penis; wide, cylindrical oviduct; short vagina, narrowing from junction with spermatheca+oviduct, and connecting to two white accessory glands; short spermatheca, variable in shape, and 2x its duct; spermatophore tapering from wide end, to middle spined/hooked section, to thin end (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

children.name: Tandonia fejervaryi
children.description:
External: Very black body; weak keel; fine skin grooves; creamy sole; clear mucous, when perturbed is thick, opaque, light blue-green (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Cylindrical epiphallus with vas deferens on apex; sharp-pointed, dense papillae inside epiphallus, penis, and vagina; cylindrical penis with a rounded papilla inside; fine penial retractor; thick-walled spermatheca without a distinct duct; vagina very long; long, thin. digital glands attached to vagina; retractor muscles on vagina; very short atrium; spermatophore with spines on flagella part, and with wide container part (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia jablanacensis
children.description:
Exterior: Narrow-bodied; dorsum and mantle black, with gray-yellow mantle edges and ochre under mantle, on neck, lower on sides; border between spermatheca and duct indistinct; keel along entire dorsum; sole yellowish with gray-yellow sides (Wagner 1930 in Wiktor 1996).

Interior: Epiphallus longer than penis, 1/2 its width; short oviduct; extremely large spermatheca+duct, 1.5x length of spermoviduct and wider, and with no differentiation between duct and spermatheca; vagina relatively long and cylindrical; small accessory glands; tubular atrium (Wagner 1930 in Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia kaleniczenkoi
children.description:
External: stout-bodied; dark body pigmented by small black dots on a cream background; lighter sides; blackish head and neck; strong, gray-cream keel; dark sole (Wiktor 1987).

Internal: small, light gray gonad; club-shaped, thick-walled epiphallus with narrowed base; club-shaped penis with narrowed apex, about length of epiphallus; strong penial retractor muscle where epiphallus joins penis; in penis are simple papilla, and longitudinal folds in apical part; long, cylindrical oviduct; spherical spermatheca clearly differentiated from its long, cylindrical duct; short vagina; two lobed accessory glands attached to vagina via short, thin ducts; large, barrel-shaped atrium with long folds inside unique to genus (Wiktor 1987).

Similar to T. cristata but darker and with large atrium; T. samsunensis has small dots on a reddish background (Wiktor 1987).

Juveniles: White to yellow body, bluish tentacles (Schikov in Wiktor 1987).

children.name: Tandonia kusceri
children.description: Tandonia kusceri is a species of slug belonging to the family Milacidae.

children.name: Tandonia lagostana
children.description: Tandonia lagostana is a species of keeled slug in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Tandonia macedonica
children.description:
External: Slender body; body black-brown, reddish, or entirely black and lighter sides; sometimes with spots, and with dark pigment in skin grooves making reticulate pattern; keel along entire dorsum; cream sole; clear mucus, opaque white when perturbed (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Epiphallus thick-walled and club-shaped; mushroom-shaped papillae in penis; fine penial retractor on epiphallus; oviduct cylindrical and longer than epiphallus; spermatheca rounded, with duct longer than penis+epiphallus; short vagina; 3-5 accessory glands on spermatheca duct and oviduct and connecting to vagina; very short atrium; golden-yellow spermatophore with a long part and many forms of hooks (Wiktor 1996).

Externally similar to T. albanica, but with mushroom-shaped penial papilla, unique spermatophore, and stout epiphallus (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia marinellii Liberto, Giglio, Colomba & Sparacio, 2012
Tandonia melanica Wiktor, 1986
children.description:
External: Black body with purplish hue when alive, black when preserved; lighter sides; cream neck under mantle; weak skin wrinkles; keel along entire dorsum to posterior mantle (when alive); cream sole; clear mucus that was unchanged when animals were perturbed (Wiktor 1987).

Internal: Relatively small genitalia; thin vas deferens joins epiphallus asymmetrically at its apex; short, conic epiphallus with small papillae internal; narrow penial muscular retractor at slight constriction between epiphallus and penis; penis is two short, rounded cylinders with a constriction between; semispherical papilla with an asymmetrical opening at constriction in penis; long folds in penis; ovate to round spermatheca with cylindrical and thin-walled duct generally shorter than spermatheca; twisted, tubular oviduct; short vagina with two sets of long accessory glands attached; short atrium; yellowish spermatophore cigar-shaped with one long end and covered with minute spines (Wiktor 1987).

Similar to black T. albanica externally, but produces a very different spermatophore (Wiktor 1987).

children.name: Tandonia nigra
children.description: Tandonia nigra is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Tandonia pageti
children.description:
Exterior: Large body and similar in shape to Limax; red-yellow body, blackish dorsum when preserved; sides and neck gray-cream; weak horseshoe-shaped mantle; fine wrinkles; gray-cream sole (Wiktor 1987).

Interior: Long epiphallus connected to side of epiphallus; cylindrical epiphallus with a bent apex, containing papillae; appendix/blind section on epiphallus; penis much wider than epiphallus, cylindrical, with a constriction; papilla between epiphallus and penis; where penis joins atrium is a fold covered by tiny spines; cylindrical oviduct; short vagina, 2x oviduct width; accessory glands on vagina; ovate spermatheca with a wide duct, wider towards base, thick-walled; cylindrical atrium about width of penis; spermatheca cigar-shaped with small spines on 1/3, and two rows of large hooks on the other 1/3 of length (Wiktor 1987).

children.name: Tandonia pinteri
children.description:
External: Black body with gray-cream sides; coloration from dense, small black spots; mantle black to dark gray with irregular bands on its sides and lighter stripe along mantle groove; black head and neck; low, light-colored keel; shallow grooves in skin; gray cream sole (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

Internal: Thin, long vas deferens; no appendix on vas deferens; short, conical epiphallus with a small hook on its end; large, rounded penis that is not very distinct from the atrium; long papilla inside penis; fine penial retractor muscle inserts between epiphallus and penis; oviduct long, cylindrical; ovate spermatheca, longer than its duct; spermatheca+duct 1-3x length, and oviduct equals length, of penis and epiphallus; short vagina; cream accessory glands like like bundled tubes attached by multiple thin ducts to vagina; short atrium attached by muscular retentors to body wall (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

children.name: Tandonia piriniana Wiktor, 1983
children.description:
External: Back-green body (black when preserved); dark grooves in skin; no lateral bands on mantle; strong, cream-colored keel; shallow grooves in skin; 3-part sole with cream middle section and dark side sections (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

Internal: Flat, ovate internal shell; relatively thick, convoluted vas deferens; appendix ("as if fused loop of vas deferens") between vas deferens and epiphallus; very long epiphallus and penis about equal in length to each other and not clearly differentiated; two simple papillae and multiple longitudinal folds in penis; penial retractor muscle on penis at position of upper papilla; epiphallus curves back toward atrium; penis narrows where it joins the atrium; cylindrical oviduct shorter than penis; long spermatheca, narrowing to apex, with wide duct; length of spermatheca + duct = penis + epiphallus; short vagina attached to small accessory glands; short atrium (Wiktor 1983, 1987).

Externally similar to T. cristata, T. kaleniczenkoi, T. schleschi (Wiktor 1983).

children.name: Tandonia rara Wiktor, 1996
children.description:
External: Narrow body; black body, head and sides; weak keel; cream sole, sometimes with black fringes (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Cylindrical epiphallus, sometimes with small papillae on middle exterior; penis+epiphallus is 1/2 the length of spermatheca+duct; cylindrical oviduct is the length of the penis+epiphallus; undetectable penial retractor muscle; ovate spermatheca, with duct as long as spermatheca; thick-walled spermatheca duct; hardened, spiny structures between vagina and atrium, and forming a rosette when everted from the body; finger-like accessory glands around vagina; atrium irregular in shape and undifferentiated from vagina (Wiktor 1996).

Juveniles: blackish (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia reuleauxi
children.description:
External: Black to brown-black body, with lighter sides; weak grooves in skin; genital opening far towards anterior of mantle; keel along along entire dorsum; gray-white sole; mucous clear, and opaque white to slightly blue-green when perturbed (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Cylindrical epiphallus with longitudinal folds inside, a bit wider at apex; penis and epiphallus undifferentiated; penis wide at its base and with papilla inside; spermatheca ovate, with thick-walled duct shorter than spermatheca itself, and longitudinal folds inside spermatheca; cylindrical oviduct; short vagina and atrium; accessory glands form "small rolls," around intersection of spermatheca duct, atrium, and vagina; spermatophore with bifurcated spines covering flagellum part, nothing on its mid-section, and rows of multi-branched spines on its posterior (Wiktor 1996).

Juveniles: may be beige in color (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia robici
children.description:
External: Thick body; green-olive to yellowish to brown-black body, with lighter sides; sometimes with some spots on mantle; black head and tentacles; white sole; weak grooves in skin; clear yellow mucous (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Cylindrical, tapering, somewhat coiled epiphallus; large convoluted fold in epiphlallus; penis short, rounded, and club-like; variable, ornamented papilla and small papillae in penis; small penial retractor on side of epiphallus; ovate spermatheca not differentiated from its duct; thin cylindrical oviduct; wide vagina with internal papillae; fingerlike accessory glands on vagina; large, ovate atrium about the length of spermatheca+duct; small, thin spermatophore with small spines only on flagellum part (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Tandonia rustica
children.description: Tandonia rustica is a species of air-breathing, keeled, land slug, a shell-less terrestrial gastropod mollusc in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Tandonia samsunensis
children.description:
External: Small, stout body; reddish body with little black spots on dorsum and mantle (animals gray-cream with dark spots after preservation); spots densest in grooves of skin; dark streaks in horseshoe groove of mantle; relatively large mantle; reddish sole with gray spots (Forcart 1942 in Wiktor 1987).

Internal: Epiphallus ovate and slightly longer than wide, and wider than penis; epiphallus with thick walls and papillae internally; short, cylindrical penis with a ring around its middle; papilla of two asymmetrically-sized lobes in penis, and small folds on internal wall towards penis base; strong penial retractor muscle at constriction between epiphallus and penis; large spermatheca with a narrowed apex and a short duct; long, cylindrical oviduct; accessory gland appears as a small grape cluster; very short atrium (Wiktor 1987)

Similar to Tandonia kaleniczenkoi and T. budapestensis, but T. kaleniczenkoi has a large atrium with internal folds and large accessory glands, and T. budapestensis has a dark sole, fewer spots on its body, with a long, cylindrical (rather than rounded) epiphallus and large, lobed accessory glands (Wiktor 1987).

children.name: Tandonia serbica
children.description: Tandonia serbica is a species of keeled slug in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Tandonia sowerbyi
children.description: Tandonia sowerbyi is a species of air-breathing, keeled, land slug, a shell-less terrestrial gastropod mollusk in the family Milacidae.

children.name: Tandonia totevi
children.description:
External: Large-bodied, resembling Limax; dark olive body with light spots and black patterns; light longitudinal stripe on mid-line and light sides; keel, 10 mm long, does not reach mantle; shallow grooves and fine wrinkles in skin, and weak horseshoe groove in mantle (Wiktor 1983).

Internal: Cylindrical epiphallus with a sharp bend, projecting the apex forward; epiphallus 2x penis length; fine penial retractor muscle on epiphallus; spool-shaped penis with swelling on one side; blunt papilla with an opening on top in penis; spermatheca long with hardly any duct; cylindrical oviduct, a bit thinner than epiphallus and same width as vagina; accessory glands agglomerated and compressed to oviduct; very short atrium (Wiktor 1983, 1987); spermatophore 15-22 mm long, with hooks only on 2/3 of length, and hooks with multiple branches (Wiktor et al. 1994).

children.name: Pachymilax
children.description: Pachymilax — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Sansania
children.description: Sansania — a genus of gastropodas.
